Version: Marketplace Listing Signal v1 Proof of Concept
Purpose: Determine whether a marketplace search link is worth opening without manual counts or individual listing acquisition.
Implemented: Removed all manually entered possible-match counts.
Added a five-model, six-marketplace automated Playwright validator.
Added conservative ListingLikely, NoListingIndicated, SourceUnavailable, Inconclusive and CheckPending states.
Only explicit zero-result language can produce NoListingIndicated.
Missing or ambiguous evidence produces Inconclusive rather than a negative result.
Generated validation records use the same SearchURL displayed to the user.
Kept individual broker sites outside automated listing validation.
Disabled the unsafe Harris & Ellis destination at source level.
LiveExecutionStatus: The validator code is complete, but Playwright browsers were not available in the build environment. Classifier logic was tested with deterministic fixtures.
